purpose: Direct-mail (Lob) conditioning + officer/email anchor for demand-side identity resolution.

columns.name: carrier_dot
columns.desc: USDOT number, normalized to an unpadded integer string. Joins across all FMCSA feeds and into the SAM↔FMCSA bridge.

columns.name: mc_number
columns.desc: MC operating-authority docket, recovered from census docket{1,2,3}{,prefix} pairs; unpadded integer string.

columns.name: legal_name
columns.desc: Registered legal business name. Primary recipient line for direct mail.

columns.name: dba_name
columns.desc: Doing-business-as name, when distinct from legal_name.

columns.name: mail_street
columns.desc: Mailing (delivery) street address — preferred for Lob send.

columns.name: mail_to_block
columns.desc: Ready-to-render multi-line delivery block: legal name / [DBA] / street / city, state zip / [country]. Mailing address preferred, physical fallback.

columns.name: mailable
columns.desc: True when a deliverable address (street + state + zip) is present. 99.98% true.

columns.name: contact_email
columns.desc: Email address on file (raw case preserved).

columns.name: email_domain
columns.desc: Bare host parsed from contact_email (after the last @, lowercased). No consumer-mailbox suppression — includes gmail.com etc.

columns.name: proxy_domain
columns.desc: Corporate web/email domain with consumer-mailbox + placeholder + regional-ISP suppression applied (NULL for shared mailboxes). The deterministic join key into the SAM↔FMCSA domain bridge. Passed through from census, not recomputed.

columns.name: officer_email_anchor
columns.desc: Soft officer↔email linkage materialized on disk as 'OFFICER NAME <email>'. The link is not asserted by FMCSA (the officer may not own the mailbox); preserved for downstream demand-side identity resolution.

columns.name: carrier_operation_label
columns.desc: Operation class label (Interstate / Intrastate Hazmat / Intrastate Non-Hazmat).

columns.name: entity_type
columns.desc: Business organization description (e.g. CORPORATION, INDIVIDUAL, PARTNERSHIP).

columns.name: power_units
columns.desc: Number of power units (fleet size proxy).

columns.name: snapshot_date
columns.desc: Census snapshot date this row was derived from.

columns.name: derived_at
columns.desc: UTC timestamp the projection was built.

example_queries.intent: Active interstate carriers in TX with a corporate domain, mailable
example_queries.sql: SELECT carrier_dot, legal_name, mail_to_block, proxy_domain, officer_name FROM census_mail_ready WHERE status_code='A' AND carrier_operation='A' AND mail_state='TX' AND proxy_domain IS NOT NULL AND mailable
SELECT carrier_dot, officer_email_anchor, power_units FROM census_mail_ready WHERE officer_email_anchor IS NOT NULL AND power_units BETWEEN 10 AND 100

example_queries.intent: Direct-mail pull for a Lob cohort
example_queries.sql: SELECT carrier_dot, mail_to_block FROM census_mail_ready WHERE mailable AND status_code='A'
